name: The Philanthropist
group: 名前だけ出てくる人物
summary: 地球に隠れ家を作った Corpus の離反者

> The Philanthropist was a renegade member of the Corpus who established his own hidden colony on Earth, an apparent paradise where rescued orphans would worship him as their savior, but which was secretly a front to acquire test subjects for his horrific experiments with the Infestation.
> He has only one appearance in the Ascension Day animated short.
